# Fetch all notes (paginated)
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
notes = []
while True:
    resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=access_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    # resp is list
    if not resp:
        break
    notes.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('notes_found', len(notes))
# Show titles/tags for quick inspection
preview = [(n['note_id'], n['title'], n.get('tags', []), n.get('pinned')) for n in notes]
print('notes_preview', preview[:15])

# Candidate notes: title or tags mention movie/quote
candidates = []
for n in notes:
    t = (n.get('title') or '').lower()
    tags = [str(x).lower() for x in (n.get('tags') or [])]
    if 'movie' in t or 'quote' in t or any(('movie' in tag) or ('quote' in tag) for tag in tags):
        candidates.append(n)

print('candidate_notes', [(n['note_id'], n['title']) for n in candidates])

import random, re
note_id = 1892
simple_creds = [c for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
login_resp = apis.simple_note.login(username='jefsmith@gmail.com', password=simple_creds['password'])
access_token = login_resp['access_token']
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
content = note['content']
# Extract quote lines like " - I see dead people."
quotes = []
for line in content.splitlines():
    line_stripped = line.strip()
    m = re.match(r'^-\s*(.+)\s*$', line_stripped)
    if m:
        quotes.append(m.group(1))
print('num_quotes', len(quotes))
print('quotes_sample', quotes[:10])
quote = random.choice(quotes) if quotes else ''
print('chosen_quote', quote)
quote
